items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and states he is interviewing Bill Allred.

ctx.x: Bill was interviewed in Orlando, Florida on February 24, 2017 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando, Florida. I’m pleased to have Bill Allred with me, trombonist and band leader and world traveler.
Done a little bit of everything.
